papers.title_en: SigmaTrace: Library-Agnostic Observability for CPU/GPU-Initiated RDMA Communication
papers.evidence: 面向GPU发起RDMA通信基础设施的细粒度可观测性
papers.tldr: RDMA已广泛用于大规模低延迟通信，但现有工具多绑定特定通信库或仅给出聚合指标，尤其无法观测GPU内核发起的RDMA操作。SigmaTrace在libibverbs/mlx5dv公共层跟踪CPU与GPU网络操作，并以低开销内存插桩捕获GPU侧行为。其在128卡NCCL与1024卡RCCL测试中开销均很低，还揭示了既有分析器遗漏的核内同步抖动和跨节点流量失衡。该工作提供了跨库、逐操作的RDMA可观测能力。
papers.abstract_en: RDMA networking enables low-latency, high-bandwidth communication on large systems. Despite its adoption, however, observability is lacking. Existing tools target specific communication libraries or only report aggregated data, missing per-operation behavior. The gap is widest for GPU-initiated networking, whose in-kernel RDMA operations are invisible to the host.   We present SigmaTrace, a library-agnostic RDMA profiling framework providing fine-grained, per-operation visibility for CPU and GPU-initiated networking. It traces operations at the libibverbs/mlx5dv layers, the common denominator beneath communication libraries on InfiniBand and RoCE, and employs a low-overhead memory interposition technique that, to our knowledge, gives the first observability into GPU-initiated RDMA without source patching or binary instrumentation.   Host-side tracing adds 1.3% overhead on NCCL AllReduce at 128 GPUs and under 2% on RCCL at 1024 GPUs. On a persistent-kernel BFS and Mixture-of-Experts inference, SigmaTrace exposes an in-kernel barrier spread and 2.13x inter-node traffic skew invisible to existing profilers.

papers.title_en: FlowMaker: From Tasks to Cost-Efficient Generative AI Workflow Deployments
papers.authors: Dimitrios Liakopoulos, Prasoon Sinha, Neeraja J. Yadwadkar
papers.evidence: 面向生成式AI工作流的集群感知低成本部署优化
papers.tldr: 生成式AI工作流由多次LLM调用组成，其流程结构、模型分配与部署配置会共同影响动态负载下的时延、成本和准确性，现有方案往往割裂优化。FlowMaker提供任务级接口，在线联合选择“工作流—模型—部署”变体，并通过约束引导、负载感知剪枝快速决策。系统还根据当前负载和资源动态复用已部署模型。相较包括Murakkab在内的基线，FlowMaker最高将有效吞吐提升10.14倍、成本降低2.77倍，证明联合在线优化可显著提高工作流服务效率。
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI workflows execute user tasks by composing sequences of LLM calls, where each call performs a sub-task (e.g., summarization or translation), forming a workflow. Executing such workflows requires decisions over workflow structure, model assignments, and deployment configurations, which jointly determine latency, cost, and accuracy under dynamic workloads and resource constraints. Existing systems optimize these decisions in isolation or fix them early, leading to suboptimal cost and goodput. We make two key observations. First, efficient serving requires jointly exploring all combinations of workflows, model choices, and deployment configurations under dynamic cluster state. Second, reuse of deployed LLMs is critical for reducing cost, but must be performed on-the-fly, as reuse depends on current load and resource availability. Together, these make selecting a workflow-variant-a combination of workflow, models, and deployment configuration-a time-critical problem. We present FlowMaker, which exposes a task-level interface and selects workflow-variants on behalf of users. To realize this, we design a constraint-guided load-aware pruning algorithm for fast, on-the-fly decisions. FlowMaker improves goodput by up to 10.14$\times$ and reduces cost by up to 2.77$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art baselines, including Murakkab.

papers.title_en: AgentDP: Towards Automated Model Deployment for Heterogeneous Embedded AI Applications
papers.authors: Leming Shen, Qiang Yang, Xinyu Huang, Zijing Ma, Yuanqing Zheng
papers.evidence: 异构设备AI模型自动部署架构
papers.tldr: 异构嵌入式设备上的预训练模型部署需面对需求表达模糊、运行环境与算子支持不匹配，以及每个新任务重复调参等问题，传统人工优化与适配成本高。AgentDP以大语言模型智能体自动编排全流程，包含需求标准化、算子感知模型切分和历史配置复用。实验显示，其适配时间最多缩短80%，相对基线平均任务准确率提升超过13%。该工作把设备领域知识融入智能体，为面向多样化嵌入式需求的高效自动部署提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents AgentDP, which aims to deploy pre-trained AI models on heterogeneous embedded devices by fully automating model optimization and adaptation (O&A) with Large Language Model (LLM) agents. AgentDP not only significantly reduces human effort via automation but also enhances model inference efficacy by integrating LLMs with device-specific domain knowledge. To deliver a robust automation framework, AgentDP develops novel solutions to address three key technical challenges: 1) To help users elicit clear requirements, we propose a user requirement standardization module; 2) To mitigate the execution environment mismatch between AI models and heterogeneous embedded devices, we design an operator-aware model partition paradigm that enables different parts of the model to be efficiently executed on distinct inference engines. 3) To avoid re-searching optimization hyperparameters for new tasks, we propose a configuration reuse module that heuristically retrieves previous hyperparameter configurations for efficient reuse. Extensive experiments demonstrate that by fully automating the entire O&A process, AgentDP reduces entire model adaptation time by up to 80% compared with manual O&A while achieving higher task accuracy (more than 13% on average) than the baselines. Additionally, a comprehensive user study also exhibits the robust generalizability of AgentDP in adapting to different user requirements for heterogeneous embedded devices.

papers.title_en: Hierarchical and Query-Aware Visual Token Pruning for High-Resolution LVLMs
papers.authors: Luther Wei, Ling Zou, Kang-Yang Huang, Yu-Syuan Xu, Wen-Huang Cheng
papers.evidence: 面向高分辨率多模态大模型的推理效率优化
papers.tldr: 高分辨率视觉语言模型同时编码全局缩略图和局部裁剪，常产生数千视觉词元，导致大语言模型推理成本高昂。现有剪枝多忽略问题语义，或在词元已进入重型语言层后才计算相关性。本文提出免训练的自顶向下分层查询感知剪枝，在实例、裁剪与词元三级联合分配预算并融合视觉显著性。于LLaVA-NeXT-7B中，保留25%词元仍达原模型98.0%性能、吞吐提升2倍，证明可高效保留细粒度关键信息。
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) preserve critical, fine-grained visual details by encoding a global thumbnail alongside multiple local crops. However, the resulting thousands of vision tokens introduce severe computational bottlenecks during Large Language Model (LLM) inference. Existing token pruning methods rely primarily on query-agnostic visual saliency, while current query-aware approaches either operate at a coarse crop-level resolution or compute token relevance too late, after vision tokens have already entered the heavy LLM layers. To address this, we propose a training-free, hierarchical token pruning framework that utilizes query guidance prior to executing any LLM blocks. Our top-down hierarchy first operates at the instance-level, dynamically scaling the vision token retention ratio of each sample based on its visual complexity. Next, at the crop-level, we distribute this sample budget across local crops using sentence-level cross-modal similarity. Finally, at the token-level, we exploit projected vision tokens alongside textual query token embeddings in the shared space to measure fine-grained alignment, applying a text-debiasing normalization to produce high-fidelity query scores. These query-guided budgets and scores are fused with local and global visual saliency metrics to select the most critical vision tokens. Extensive experiments on LLaVA-NeXT-7B demonstrate that our plug-and-play framework retains 98.0% and 94.8% of unpruned performance at 25% and 10% vision token retention, respectively. Notably, at 25% retention, our method delivers a 2.0x inference throughput speedup and even surpasses the unpruned baseline on POPE by 0.7 points.

papers.title_en: Torch-DPhys: A Torch-Native, MOOSE-Compatible Framework for Differentiable Physics Simulation and Hybrid Machine Learning Integration
papers.evidence: 支持CPU和GPU执行的PyTorch原生可微仿真框架
papers.tldr: 核工程热工水力与多物理场仿真需要既保持离散求解可靠性、又能提供梯度的计算工具。Torch-DPhys以PyTorch原生张量实现兼容MOOSE/SAM概念的可微残差与伴随灵敏度，并支持CPU/GPU、部分编译核及稀疏直接求解。其在弹性、回路瞬态和熔盐快堆算例中与参考实现高度一致，堆芯场最大归一化差异为1.13×10^-5。进一步完成参数反演和可微控制训练，为基于梯度的推断、优化和物理机器学习耦合提供基础。
papers.abstract_en: We present Torch-DPhys, a Torch-native framework implemented in PyTorch for differentiable physics simulation and hybrid physics-machine learning. It implements selected thermal-hydraulic modeling concepts and discretizations from MOOSE's Thermal Hydraulics Module and the System Analysis Module (SAM), with a preliminary extension to continuum mechanics. Native tensor residuals support CPU and GPU execution, compilation of selected numerical kernels, and sparse direct linear solves. Sensitivities are obtained by differentiating executed numerical operations or through discrete adjoints of converged residual equations. Verification combines analytical solutions, reference-code comparisons, and derivative checks. Demonstrations cover plane-strain elasticity, one- and two-loop thermal-hydraulic transients, and an axisymmetric molten-salt fast reactor. For the reactor, comparison with SAM-Lite gives a maximum normalized field discrepancy of 1.13 x 10^-5 over 200 adaptive time steps, demonstrating agreement between the tested discrete implementations. Selected transient sensitivities are assessed using tangent-linear calculations and finite differences on fixed time schedules. Two applications illustrate the framework's connection between simulation and optimization. A residual-adjoint parameter-identification calculation recovers nominal pump head and heating power with relative errors below 0.06% from noiseless synthetic MOOSE observations. A separate three-loop plant demonstration uses solver-in-the-loop training of a predictive controller by differentiating trajectory-level objectives through the thermal-hydraulic simulation. These examples illustrate a foundation for gradient-based inference, control, and coupled physics-machine learning models in nuclear engineering.

papers.title_en: Dual-Slot: From Serial Loops to Parallel Slots in Language Models
papers.authors: Yiqin Hao, Zitong Wang, Boyi Zeng, He Li, Shixiang Song, Feichen Song, Yifan Liu, Zhouhan Lin
papers.evidence: 降低延迟的并行大模型计算架构
papers.tldr: 循环式语言模型通过重复调用共享层增加计算深度，但迭代间的串行依赖会显著拖慢自回归解码。Dual-Slot将计算重组为并行的潜变量槽与预测槽：前者为下一步生成深层状态，后者融合前一词元深层状态和当前表示进行预测。训练时以少量雅可比迭代并行细化序列状态。在1B稠密模型上，验证困惑度由7.25降至7.00，九项五样本任务平均准确率提升2.26个百分点，同时基本保持原始解码吞吐，证明其能以较低时延获得循环计算收益。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models increase computational depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to improve model quality without adding parameters. However, sequential dependencies between loop iterations increase autoregressive decoding latency. We introduce Dual-Slot, an architecture that reorganizes serial looped computation into parallel latent and prediction slots. Rather than waiting for the current token's latent computation to finish, the prediction slot combines the previous token's deep latent state with the current representation, while the latent slot produces a state for the next decoding step. This shifts the latent dependency across adjacent tokens, replacing two sequential module invocations with a single paired invocation while preserving standard autoregressive generation. To preserve token-level parallelism during training, we use a small number of Jacobi iterations to refine latent states across the sequence in parallel. Experiments on Qwen-style dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models show consistent improvements in language modeling and average downstream accuracy. On the 1B dense model, Dual-Slot reduces Pile validation perplexity from 7.25 to 7.00 and improves average five-shot accuracy across nine task configurations by 2.26 percentage points. After supervised fine-tuning, it improves zero-shot GSM8K accuracy by 5.83 and 3.49 percentage points for the 1B dense and A0.6B MoE models, respectively. Across the evaluated batch sizes, Dual-Slot retains 93.1-96.5% of vanilla decoding throughput for the dense model and 98.1-99.6% for the MoE model.

papers.title_en: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
papers.authors: Liana Patel, Rishabh Ranjan, Ion Stoica, Matei Zaharia, Carlos Guestrin
papers.evidence: 面向大模型预填充的计算与内存优化
papers.tldr: 长上下文预填充阶段需让所有输入词元逐层参与计算，导致首词延迟和显存开销高。TokenGate为已训练模型加入轻量级、可学习的词元剪枝组件，并以词元门控注意力绕开Top-K不可微问题。在多类任务中，它在不损失精度下实现1.4—11.3倍更快首词生成与1.5—3.4倍更低峰值内存。该方法可适配标准及混合注意力模型，为长上下文高效推理提供参数高效的改造路径。
papers.abstract_en: Expert human readers process large inputs (e.g., code repositories and long documents) by skimming to closely read only what matters. On the other hand, language models process all input tokens through each model layer, resulting in significant processing costs for long-context inputs. We introduce TokenGate, a small, drop-in component that extends existing trained models to enable end-to-end learnable token pruning over long-context inputs for fast and memory-efficient prefill. To enable end-to-end learning despite the non-differentiable top-K operator for token pruning, we introduce token-gated attention, a mechanism inspired by Mixture-of-Experts that re-weights attention logits using token importance scores. Across diverse tasks, TokenGate achieves $1.4$-$11.3\times$ faster time-to-first token (TTFT) and $1.5$-$3.4\times$ lower peak memory at no accuracy degradation for prefill in transformers. Compared to the best-performing prior methods for token-pruning, TokenGate gives up to $6.4\times$ faster prefill and $2\times$ lower peak memory. TokenGate natively extends both standard transformers (e.g., Qwen3) and hybrid-attention models (e.g., Qwen3.5) with simple lightweight adaptation comparable to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning. We make our code available at: https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate.

papers.title_en: Learning to Refer: Inference-Time Collaboration in Decentralized Federated Learning
papers.authors: Yuheng Ma, Chendi Wang, Qiong Zhang
papers.evidence: 去中心化联邦学习协作与路由机制
papers.tldr: 去中心化联邦学习中，异构客户端拥有互补专长，但查询通常只在到达节点本地推理，难以利用邻居知识。论文将协作推理建模为受预算约束、仅沿图邻边进行的本地专家转介。EdgeDRM学习各客户端的密度路由势能，以邻居势能差选择下一跳，并聚合访问节点的预测。理论分析刻画比较估计与密度增益，实验显示其多数场景优于图结构匹配基线，尤其适合稀疏连接网络。
papers.abstract_en: In decentralized federated learning, heterogeneous clients may develop complementary expertise, yet each query is typically evaluated only by the client where it arrives. To exploit this distributed expertise without global coordination, we formulate inference-time collaboration as budgeted local expert referral, a graph-constrained routing process in which a query can move only between neighboring clients and only visited clients contribute to its final prediction. EdgeDRM implements this framework by learning a density-based routing potential for each client: differences between neighboring potentials provide the comparisons used to select successive referrals, while local task models generate predictions that are aggregated along the resulting route. Both training and inference are decentralized, using only neighbor-local information without a central router or graph-wide client scoring. We establish estimation guarantees for the learned comparisons and characterize how local improvement and graph structure govern prior-weighted density gains from referral. Experiments on benchmark and real-world medical data show that EdgeDRM outperforms graph-matched decentralized baselines in most settings, with the clearest benefits under sparse connectivity.

papers.title_en: GRaSP: Latency-Aware Optimization for Geo-Distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Hardik Ruparel, Raj Kumar Pandey, Pramod Kumar
papers.evidence: 面向地理分布式RAG服务的基础设施优化
papers.tldr: 面向跨地域云边部署的检索增强生成，传统仅按语义相关性选文档，会忽视内容位置，导致广域网尾延迟、跨区费用与数据驻留约束失衡。GRaSP作为无需重训的重排序层，以延迟衰减相关性并可加入费用惩罚，在数量及区域配额约束下选择上下文。其基础问题可由贪心算法最优求解；实验中将P90抓取延迟降低41%，仍保留相关性排序78%的召回。该工作为地理分布式RAG提供了可部署的质量—时延权衡机制。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly served across geo-distributed cloud and edge infrastructures, where wide-area latency, cross-region egress cost, and data-residency rules compete with retrieval quality. Conventional pipelines rank by semantic similarity alone and ignore where content lives, inflating tail latency and cost. We formalize the Geo-RAG Selection Problem (GRaSP), a drop-in re-scoring layer that decays relevance by latency and adds an optional cost penalty under a cardinality budget and per-region caps, with no retraining. We first settle its complexity: the base formulation is a linear objective over a partition matroid, solved optimally by an O(N log N) greedy algorithm, rather than NP-hard as a knapsack framing suggests, with hardness entering only under an additive egress budget. On a five-node CloudLab testbed emulating a four-region WAN over the Natural Questions corpus (2.68M passages), GRaSP's benefit is placement-dependent: under uniform placement it cuts fetch latency at negligible quality cost; under topical (residency-like) placement it traces a recall-latency Pareto frontier that dominates relevance-only, nearest-k, and a latency-budgeted baseline. At a moderate latency setting, GRaSP lowers P90 fetch latency by 41% while retaining 78% of relevance-only's recall, with sub-millisecond selection overhead, stable to 200 queries/s. Findings generalize across four public BEIR benchmarks. In end-to-end question answering, GRaSP reduces context-fetch latency by 43% while remaining within 0.062 absolute EM of relevance-only retrieval.

papers.title_en: SpikeDuet: CPU-Accelerator Co-Execution of Sparse SNNs on Commodity MCUs
papers.authors: Muhammad Fahd Ibrahim Bhatti, Muhammad Ali Siddiqi
papers.evidence: 面向神经推理的异构CPU与加速器协同执行系统
papers.tldr: 商品级微控制器虽集成面向稠密计算的矩阵向量加速器，但其能否有效加速具有事件稀疏性的脉冲神经网络尚不明确。本文在EFR32MG24上构建CPU与MVP协同执行流程，结合硬件标定的引擎选择、保持功能的神经元重排及异步并行调度。五种网络配置中，异构执行较优化的Cortex-M33事件驱动实现提速1.27至1.87倍，并将单次推理能耗降低11%至34%。结果表明，活动局部性与CPU—加速器并发可使通用MCU更高效地运行稀疏SNN。
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) expose sparse event activity, but commodity microcontrollers increasingly pair general-purpose processors with dense matrix-vector accelerators whose suitability for sparse inference is unclear. We investigate whether the on-chip Matrix Vector Processor (MVP) of the EFR32MG24 can accelerate SNN inference beyond optimized event-driven Cortex-M33 execution. Our automated snnTorch-to-C deployment flow combines hardware-calibrated engine selection, function-preserving neuron reordering that places co-active neurons adjacently for the accelerator, and asynchronous scheduling that overlaps CPU and MVP computation. On physical hardware, heterogeneous execution achieves 1.27--1.87$\times$ speedup and 11--34\% lower energy per inference than optimized sparse Cortex-M33 execution across five evaluated network configurations, while the smallest Braille network remains CPU-optimal. Reordering alone moves Braille-384's dominant hidden layer from the CPU to the MVP, and its benefit persists under asynchronous execution. These results show that activity locality and concurrency between CPU and MVP can jointly improve sparse SNN inference on commodity MCUs.

papers.title_en: Toward Collective Model Intelligence: Characterizing and Coordinating Models
papers.authors: SinapisAI Team, Jian-Dong Liu, Qun Dai, Zhendong Du, Guannan Lai, Hao-Yu Liu, Yi-Fan Ma, Zi-Yu Mao, Tengzhong Sun, Xin-Yi Zhang, Zi-Chen Zhao, Gelin Bian, Zongyuan Cai, Ju Cang, Zhangqin Chen, Shilei Gu, Guoding Ji, Taojian Jiang, Hao-Xuan Ma, Fan Wu, Lin-Xing Wu, Tao Yu, Xiao Zhang, Tianyi Zhou, Rong Gu, Ming Li, Zhi-Hao Tan, Han-Jia Ye, Yang Yu, De-Chuan Zhan
papers.evidence: 面向资源约束的多模型编排与协同
papers.tldr: 独立开发的模型能力各异且互补，但模型数量增长并不会自然形成可协作的集体智能。论文提出“集体模型智能”框架：以 Model Eval 在有限评测下构建能力画像，以 Mio 按任务和成本组织模型协作，并由 Mos 高效调度执行。实验中，Mio 1.0 Lite 在九个公开基准上兼具最高平均得分与最低平均成本，预热共享缓存还将模型文件获取加速至23.3倍。该工作为大规模异构模型的评估、选择、协作与部署提供了系统基础。
papers.abstract_en: Independently developed AI models accumulate diverse and complementary capabilities, but a growing model collection does not automatically realize Collective AI. Addressing this gap requires understanding model capabilities with limited evaluation, organizing complementary models to collaborate on diverse tasks, and executing model calls efficiently under resource constraints. We present a systematic approach to pursuing Collective Model Intelligence through three connected components. First, Model Eval constructs evidence-based capability profiles by combining query-level performance estimation with cross-domain prediction, reducing the need for exhaustive evaluation. Second, Mio (Models in One) organizes complementary model candidates and supports task-conditioned, cost-aware selection and collaboration as task requirements evolve. Third, Mos (Model Serving OS) separates model selection from execution and provides endpoint scheduling and shared model deployment and distribution. Experiments show lower capability-estimation errors under limited evaluation. Across nine public benchmarks, Mio 1.0 Lite achieves the highest average score and lowest average cost among compared methods, with per-request costs 73.7-97.5% lower than those of the best-scoring alternatives. A prewarmed shared cache accelerates model-file retrieval by up to 23.3 times. This work lays a foundation for Collective Model Intelligence by characterizing and coordinating the diverse capabilities of an expanding model universe.

papers.title_en: DeGMatch: Target-Aware Reasoning Data Selection via Deconfounded Gradient Matching
papers.authors: Changho Lee, Janghoon Han, Rajdeep Mukherjee, Yeda Song, Lening Nick Cui, Xinya Du, Honglak Lee
papers.evidence: 降低大规模语言模型后训练成本的数据选择方法
papers.tldr: 长轨迹推理后训练虽能提升大模型能力，但大规模数据代价高，且现有目标感知筛选难区分细粒度目标。DeGMatch先以目标相关性门控过滤候选，再利用模型梯度重排。它对候选梯度做总体均值中心化并去除主成分方向，抑制主导性群体结构干扰。在数学、科学和代码任务及不同预算、模型和规模下均优于多类基线，为面向专长的高效推理数据选择提供方法。
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning post-training on long trajectories has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but scaling such training to large datasets is increasingly expensive. We study target-aware reasoning data selection, where a small reference set specifies a target capability and guides the selection of training trajectories for specialization. We find that existing target-aware methods can exhibit limited target discrimination on long reasoning trajectories, while dominant population-level structure in candidate gradients can obscure finer target-dependent variation during gradient matching. To address these limitations, we introduce Deconfounded Gradient Matching (DeGMatch), which first constructs a target-relevance gate and then reranks candidates using model-specific gradients. DeGMatch centers gradients using the candidate-population mean and removes leading principal directions before target matching, reducing the influence of dominant population-level structure and improving target discrimination. Across mathematics, science, and code, DeGMatch outperforms strong heuristic, target-aware, and reasoning-specific data selection baselines, while remaining effective across selection budgets, model families, and scales. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/CHLee0801/degmatch.

papers.title_en: ReTrace: Visual Backtracking for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Guangzong Si, Dong Wang, Yifan Yu, Miao Liu, Panwang Pan, Wentao Zhu
papers.evidence: 通过降低视觉令牌与键值缓存开销优化多模态大模型推理
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型将图像编码为大量视觉词元，带来显著注意力计算与键值缓存开销；现有浅层剪枝会将暂时不重要的词元永久删除。论文发现视觉枢纽在中层会回溯检索早期低显著性词元的上下文。ReTrace以休眠状态缓存非枢纽词元，并在回溯窗口恢复、信息吸收后再剪枝。在两类模型上，该方法将浮点计算量和键值缓存均降低近九成，预填充提速2.83倍且保持复杂视觉语言任务性能。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) encode images into dense visual token sequences, creating substantial attention and KV-cache overhead. Existing visual token compression methods reduce this cost by pruning low-saliency tokens in shallow layers, but this practice couples temporary computational deactivation with irreversible information deletion. We show that this coupling breaks an intrinsic inference pattern in MLLMs. Through layer-wise attention analysis, we identify \textbf{Visual Backtracking}: visual pivots remain spatially stable, yet in middle layers they actively retrieve context from tokens that appeared unimportant earlier. Thus, early low-saliency tokens can be inactive for computation while still being useful for later reasoning. Motivated by this finding, we propose \textbf{ReTrace}, a backtracking-aware compression framework that introduces a dormant token state. ReTrace caches non-pivot tokens outside expensive layer-wise computation, restores them during the backtracking window, and prunes only after their information has been absorbed. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3 demonstrate nearly 90\% reductions in FLOPs and KV cache, a 2.83$\times$ prefilling speedup, and strong performance retention across complex vision-language benchmarks.

papers.title_en: AdaFedXplain: Adaptive Federated Learning with Explainable AI for Ransomware Detection
papers.authors: Md. Emran Biswas, Md. Delowar Hossain, Mst. Tanbin Yasmin Tanny, Muhammad Aminur Rahaman, Md Al Amin, Tangina Sultana
papers.evidence: 面向去中心化模型训练的自适应联邦学习
papers.tldr: 勒索软件正演化为针对关键基础设施的多阶段攻击，集中式检测既难应对零日变种，也带来数据隐私风险。论文提出AdaFedXplain，在四个操作系统形成的非独立同分布客户端上进行自适应联邦训练，并结合SHAP提供可解释性。系统以渐进式XGBoost复杂度、衰减学习率和按感染率及数据充足度的客户端分级提升稳定性和效率。实验在62485个真实样本上取得99.59%准确率、99.64% F1，并显著降低能耗、延迟与通信开销，兼顾隐私、性能和分析可用性。
papers.abstract_en: Attacks using ransomware have developed into complex multiphase campaigns that target vital infrastructure, resulting in annual damages of billions of dollars. Conventional detection techniques are ineffective against zero-day variations, and privacy issues are raised by centralized machine learning algorithms. Federated learning allows for cooperative model training without data sharing, however current FL approaches suffer from explainability issues, high communication cost, and non-IID data heterogeneity. In this study, we present AdaFedXplain, an explainable AI-based adaptive federated learning system for ransomware detection. Our approach includes progressive XGBoost complexity to avoid overfitting, a decaying learning rate schedule for stable convergence, and dynamic client grading based on ransomware prevalence and data sufficiency. Using 62,485 real-world ransomware samples from four OS-based non-IID clients, we compare AdaFedXplain against FedAvg, FedProx, and SCAFFOLD. According to experimental data, AdaFedXplain outperforms all baselines with 99.59% detection accuracy and 99.64% F1-score while cutting energy usage by 75%, latency by 65%, and communication overhead by 75%. The ablation investigation demonstrates that every element enhances performance. Security analysts can use SHAP explainability to identify important PE header characteristics that influence detection decisions. Our system provides a collaborative ransomware detection solution that is efficient and interpretable, while reducing privacy risks through federated learnings data-local training paradigm.
